facts.fact: Fonaredd reports a workshop on 26 February 2026 presented an evaluation of pilot initiatives for the land information system and proposed an e-SIF 2.0 architecture of digitised archives, a GIS digital cadastre and digitised transactions, with deployment still to come.
Fonaredd reports a feasibility study of a land atlas documented 151 land administrations across 26 provinces, and the proposed e-SIF 2.0 would digitise land archives and build a GIS digital cadastre.
